desc: Derive the exact effect of pivot operations and identify token-order and contraction invariants.
Characterize reachability from \(A\) to \(B\), including impossibility conditions.
Develop and justify the greedy feasibility test and binary-search minimum operation count.
Validate the characterization against the provided sample tests.
Implement the Python solution with fast I/O and acceptable \(O((\sum N)\log N)\) complexity.
